_about: Narration beats for the WhatsApp Commerce V2 portfolio video (built by bin/demo; see README.md). Every claim traces to docs/evidence/PORTFOLIO_CLAIMS.md. Figures are spelled out for speech. Segments 02-04 show SYNTHETIC demo data (a local database, same code, Meta replaced by an in-process fake) and carry an on-screen label saying so; the first beat of segment 02 shows fresh phone captures of the live catalog and cart (nothing sent); segment 05 shows REAL verification evidence from 2026-10-06 as evidence cards (no live Meta traffic, no real customer data). Voice: Kokoro-82M af_heart at speed 0.95.

beats.text: WhatsApp Commerce, version two: a production-oriented reference implementation of ordering on WhatsApp.
Version one's logs showed it dropped every delivery status and hid its errors. Version two is the rebuild.

beats.visual: fresh phone captures of the live WhatsApp catalog and cart (labelled, cart not sent)
beats.text: A customer orders inside WhatsApp's own catalog.

beats.visual: admin conversation of the synthetic hero customer
beats.text: This walkthrough uses invented demo data. Maya asks about the menu, gets the catalog, and sends her order.

beats.visual: order detail: lines, quantities, catalog prices, review clear
beats.text: Each webhook is verified and stored before it's processed, then applied once. The order is checked against the catalog.
Once accepted, the reply goes through an outbox, tracked by the statuses Meta sends back: sent, delivered, read.

beats.visual: deliveries list + a delivery with a duplicate outcome
beats.text: Every delivery is kept with its outcome, so duplicates are ignored and replays are safe.

beats.visual: Health page: failed by category, unknown, blocked, replayed
beats.text: Failures stay visible: an ambiguous send is never resent, and a closed twenty-four-hour window blocks instead of sending.
On October sixth it ran against real Meta traffic. The first catalog card failed: error one three one, zero zero nine.

beats.visual: 131009 card: stored details, diagnosis, manual fix, next message
beats.text: Its stored details pointed at a commerce setting on the new number. Once that was fixed by hand in Meta, the next message, and a real order, went through.
One thousand one hundred and eleven specs, green CI with Brakeman and bundler-audit, deployed over HTTPS with a tested restore.
Verified against real traffic. Not a claim of long-term production reliability.
